welcome.title: Testing session
welcome.text: Use your hands in Frametop as you always do, for up to 3 minutes. The cameras record them, and what the hand tracking made of them.|Something went wrong? Press the headset button right then: it marks the moment. Hold the button to finish.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! Upload it from the Hand recorder window, so new versions of the hand tracking can be tested on it.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. You can upload it from the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Testing session
sections.intro: Use Frametop as you normally would: point, tap, pinch, drag and scroll windows. Do what gives you trouble.

prompts.text: Use Frametop as you normally would.|This panel goes away while you record. Press the headset button when something goes wrong; hold it to finish.
